messages:
olivia: :loudspeaker: Quick heads-up — Monthly All-Hands next Thursday 10:00 PT (hybrid). Please RSVP with a reaction. Agenda + asks below — drop Qs in this thread or add to the shared doc by Tue EOD. Recording will be posted after the meeting: https://redwood.app/recordings/3141592653

olivia: Agenda (high-level)
• 10:00 — Exec updates (org health & hires) — 10m
• 10:10 — Product snapshot: SmartBatch + roadmap highlights — 12m
• 10:22 — Dedicated capacity SLA & pricing callouts — 7m
• 10:30 — Ops incident recap (brief RCA + mitigations) — 5m
• 10:36 — Customer spotlight + wins — 5m
• 10:42 — Q&A + closing — rest of session

olivia: Additions: 5m allotment for quick live demo if product wants it. Please keep slides to 2–3 each.

mike: Can we add a 5m slot specifically for Dedicated latency improvements? quick callouts on perf gains.

olivia: Yep — slot added under SLA section. Thanks @mike

jamal: Will SmartBatch demo include perf numbers vs. baseline? I can bring a benchmark slide if helpful.

olivia: That would be perfect — pls 1 slide with before/after p50/p95. adding demo slot for you.

sara: Heads-up for people ops logistics — hybrid snacks for SF office, and we need an attendee list for catering by Wed noon. Also I’ll post accessibility captioning info separately.

olivia: Noted, @sara — I'll ping people to react for RSVP so we can hand off counts.

andrew: Ops suggestion — include a 2 slide incident summary: timeline + root cause + next steps. Keeps it tight and useful for product/eng.

olivia: Good call, @andrew. We'll keep it to 2 slides (timeline + mitigation).

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release/2024-05-03 -> prod @ 2024-05-03T09:37:00Z (sha: b7c3f4d)

olivia: Shared prep doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-example-link — please add slides and any Qs by Tue EOD. If you want to run through slides, ping me and I'll schedule a quick dry run.

mike: :thumbsup:

jamal: Will the slide deck and recording be published for folks who can't attend? prefer PDF in the shared drive.

olivia: Yes — PDF + recording + a 1-paragraph summary will be posted in #all-hands and attached to the meeting invite within 24h of the session.

olivia: Quick asks summary: react to RSVP, add Qs to the doc, slide owners: keep to 2–3 slides, benchmarks for demos, catering RSVP by Wed noon. Thanks all! :sparkles:
